note: 'He said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends. For you have not spoken about Me accurately, as My servant Job has' (Job 42:7)
'take seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves' (Job 42:8)
'My servant Job will pray for you, for I will accept his prayer' (Job 42:8); 'the LORD accepted Job's prayer' (Job 42:9): Job prays for Eliphaz and his two friends
